director.responsibility: Turn the input into the film this round is to make: its focus and what comes first, the script, the shot list, the direction of picture and sound, and the delivery specification each cut is judged against, without deciding how a part is made. Keep every position working toward the same film, hand each cut that is to be screened to the screening owner as a release of your own repository, and lock the film only after you have watched the cut yourself and weighed what the checks and the screenings found.
deliverables: at least one nonempty role artifact

production-designer.responsibility: Decide how the film's characters, places, props and style look, and keep them the same from the first shot to the last: write down what defines each, publish the design and reference images as releases of your repository, and supply the views and references the picture needs. Where a shot cannot hold a design, or a design is missing or contradicts itself, settling it is your part.
deliverables: at least one nonempty role artifact

dp.responsibility: Make each shot's picture from the shot list, the designs and the animatic, key frames first and then the shots, at the timing the timeline gives them. Publish each batch as a release of your repository and keep a log of every shot: what it shows, which design and direction it follows, and which release holds it. Where a shot cannot hold a design, raise it with the design owner instead of changing the design.
deliverables: at least one nonempty role artifact

sound-designer.responsibility: Make the film's sound: dialogue, music and effects, in sync with the timeline, and the mix. Publish stems and mixes as releases of your repository, keep a cue sheet of what plays where and which release holds it, and bring the sound back into sync with each new cut.
deliverables: at least one nonempty role artifact

editor.responsibility: Hold the film's timeline from the animatic to the locked cut: what plays when, for how long and with which sound. Cut the animatic from the script, the shot list and the dialogue so that picture and sound can be made to it, assemble the shots and sounds you are supplied, render each cut, and publish each cut meant to be reviewed, checked or screened as a release of your repository, saying what changed. Ask the position that makes what the timeline is missing.
deliverables: at least one nonempty role artifact

qc.responsibility: Check each cut against the delivery specification, the designs and the original film: picture, sound, sync, continuity and technical faults, each with the cut and the timecode where it shows. Report each fault to the position that owns the affected part, and give each cut a lock-or-fix recommendation with the faults that decide it.
deliverables: at least one nonempty role artifact

test-audience.responsibility: Watch each cut you are handed from start to end as someone seeing the film for the first time, and record what you experienced, with timecodes: where it held you, where you were confused, bored or lost, what you understood of the story and the characters. Say which cut you watched and how, and report the experience, not a craft review.
deliverables: at least one nonempty role artifact
